data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 the Syndicate released GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2015: GBP 95.7m), arising predominantly from the Energy and Treaty Divisions (2015: primarily from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2016.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2016 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,609.0m and recorded a net release of prior-year technical reserves of GBP 95.7m in 2016 (a release representing approximately 5.95% of opening gross claims outstanding). The releases were reported as arising predominantly in the Energy and Treaty divisions and attributed to favourable claims development on losses during 2016. No per-line quantified prior-year movements were disclosed.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions, Claims outstanding) on page 15. Prior year movement (release of GBP 95.7m) taken from the Movement in prior year's provision note on page 23 and treated as a gross figure as stated in the note. Named loss events mentioned in the managing agent narrative (page 2) are not quantified in the accounts. Claims development triangle is present on page 30 but OCR of the triangle in the provided images was unclear; therefore detailed triangle cells were not reliably extracted. Gross premium mix taken from the segmental analysis (Direct insurance categories) on page 22 with a consolidated Reinsurance acceptances total. Small negative premium for 'Motor (other classes)' is printed as (0.3) in the source.
